# `em select profile set`

- **Usage:** `em select profile set <TARGET>`

Set the profile by list number or path (cross-aware: no arch check)

## Arguments
- **`<TARGET>`** — Profile list number (from `list`) or path (e.g. `default/linux/riscv/23.0/rv64/lp64d`)

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
